trap.label: reporting passive
trap.right: Wages must be taken into account.
trap.why: Em português “devem ser levados em conta” e “devem levar” soam parecidos. Em inglês, wages recebe a ação: passiva.

mcq.q: It is estimated ___ one in five is poor.

fix.right: Wages must be taken into account.

fix.wrong: It is estimate that one in five is poor.
fix.right: It is estimated that one in five is poor.

fix.wrong: The firm is said to grew fast.
fix.right: The firm is said to have grown fast.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “We must take wages into account.”
rewrite.answer: Wages must be taken into account.

rewrite.prompt: Relato: “People say the firm grew fast.” (The firm…)
rewrite.answer: The firm is said to have grown fast.

rewrite.prompt: Com it: “Experts estimate that one in five is poor.”
rewrite.answer: It is estimated that one in five is poor.
